name: OpenBao secrets
description: Loads secrets from OpenBao (KV v2) into the environment of every process in the container: VS Code and its extensions, terminals, the lifecycle hooks of other features, AI agents. The container fetches its own secrets (AppRole, response-wrapped secret_id or token) into a memory-only cache, so nothing depends on the attaching client's localEnv. Optionally installs the bao CLI. Also self-heals your devcontainer setup.

paths.description: Comma-separated KV v2 paths to load, e.g. 'shared/font-awesome,orgs/my-org'. Later paths override earlier ones on a duplicate key. Each key becomes an environment variable of the same name.

mount.description: Mount path of the KV v2 secrets engine.

address.description: OpenBao server address, e.g. 'https://bao.example.com:8200'. BAO_ADDR in the container's environment wins when set.

installCli.description: Also install the bao CLI from openbao/openbao GitHub releases (checksum verified). The loader itself only needs curl and jq.

version.description: bao CLI version when installCli is true: latest, or a release such as 2.7.2.
